description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kolinjadiya, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District Case. No. 410014 (24/1050)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Nos. 14, 94, and 95) with detailed property information including owner names, land extent, title class, encumbrances, and specific location details. The content falls under PART III - LANDS and involves the formal registration and determination of land titles, which clearly fits the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
